Leave unknown fields blank; a screenshot helps the most.

- AI 公司 / AI company:
- 订阅方案 / Subscription plan:

- 地区（国内站 / 国际站）/ Region (China site / international site):
- 模型（含 effort，如有）/ Model (incl. effort, if any):
- 统计工具（ccusage / Codex / 厂商面板 / 其他）/ Measurement tool (ccusage / Codex / vendor panel / other):

- 统计期内 token：total / 普通输入 / 缓存读取 / 缓存写入 / 输出（MTokens 或原始数均可，注明单位）/ Tokens during the window: total / fresh input / cache read / cache write / output (MTokens or raw counts — state the unit):
- 字段口径：input 是否已包含 cache_read？output 是否包含 reasoning？/ Field semantics: does input already include cache_read? Does output include reasoning?
- 截图或来源链接 / Screenshot or source link:
